2610.08432.title: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
2610.08432.paper_summary: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.
2610.08432.paper_summary_zh: 改善具身代理通常專注於通過訓練來優化基礎模型，而控制規劃、上下文和工具使用的周邊代理則通常是工程設計的。我們詢問這個控制系統是否可以直接從稀疏環境反饋的經驗痕跡中自我改進。我們提出了具身代理控制優化（EMHO），這是一個自我演化的框架，保持具身模型不變，並通過分析執行軌跡和先前的控制歷史來迭代修訂其控制系統。EMHO 超越了技能或恢復提示，修改了代理如何監控進展、使用視覺工具、基於觀察進行推理以及對失敗的反應。為了支持單一控制系統下的多個子任務，我們引入了 EMHO-Merge，這通過使用情節級的收益和損失來指導證據支持的修訂行為的應用時機和方式，解決了在子任務間共同優化單一共享控制系統的權衡。我們在 EmbodiedBench 上對 EMHO 進行了導航和操作任務的評估，EMHO 持續提高了 Qwen 9B 和 27B 模型的任務成功率。質性分析顯示，EMHO 不僅僅是從失敗和無效行動中恢復，而是重塑了具身代理如何解釋和與其環境互動。
